pairs.question: Sed nunc quid faciam?
pairs.answer: Vis me tenet ipsa sacrorum, et carmen demens carmine laesus amo.
pairs.derivation: Ovid poses a self-question and answers it in the same couplet. Question is the interrogative 'sed nunc quid faciam?' (first-word capitalized, terminal '?' kept). Answer is the contiguous remainder of the distich that follows the question mark, ending at the line's full stop: 'vis me tenet ipsa sacrorum, et carmen demens carmine laesus amo.' Nothing omitted within the span; the following couplet ('sic nova Dulichio lotos...') is illustrative elaboration and is cut.
